prompt: Find ChinaJoy side events worth applying to, then draft applications I can review.
interpretation: You want a short list of real ChinaJoy-adjacent events, checked against organizers, then tailored application drafts. Nothing goes out until you say so.

nodes.label: Find events on the web
nodes.summary: Search the open web for ChinaJoy side events, satellite gatherings and adjacent meetups.
nodes.instructions: Run broad and narrow web queries for events around ChinaJoy. Collect name, date, organizer and link.

nodes.label: Verify relevance
nodes.summary: Check each candidate is real, current and actually related.
nodes.instructions: Cross-check dates, organizers and venues. Drop duplicates, stale listings and unrelated events.

nodes.label: Scan social chatter
nodes.summary: Watch social platforms for event announcements that never hit event sites.
nodes.instructions: Search social platforms for ChinaJoy side-event announcements, host callouts and RSVP links.

nodes.label: Confirm social finds
nodes.summary: Separate real announcements from noise and hype.
nodes.instructions: Verify each social find against an organizer account or registration page before keeping it.

nodes.label: Merge verified events
nodes.summary: Combine all verified events into one deduplicated list.
nodes.instructions: Merge branch outputs, dedupe by name and date, keep the best source per event.

nodes.label: Prioritize opportunities
nodes.summary: Rank events by fit, reach and application effort.
nodes.instructions: Score each event on audience fit, strategic value and effort. Select the top items for drafting.

nodes.label: Draft applications
nodes.summary: Write a tailored application for each priority event.
nodes.instructions: For each selected event, draft an application with positioning tailored to that event's audience.

nodes.label: Your review
nodes.summary: Nothing is submitted until you approve the drafts.
nodes.instructions: Present drafts for approval. Capture edits as preference notes for future drafting.

nodes.label: Package approved applications
nodes.summary: Hand back only the drafts you approved.
nodes.instructions: Collect approved drafts. Omit rejected items. Return files and a short cover note.

loops.until: until every selected event has a draft
